search_console_query_performance: Read stored Search Console performance for an inclusive date range, up to 366 days and the task snapshot. Group or filter by native dimensions. CTR is total clicks divided by impressions. Average position is total position_sum divided by impressions. Query dimensions or filters exclude hidden queries. Totals can include them. Follow nextStartRow until hasMore is false.
search_console_inspect_url: Read a stored URL inspection for the configured property. Return index, crawl and canonical fields. This does not call Google. observedAt is the stored observation time when available. A missing observation time is unavailable evidence. lastCrawlTime is a different event.
search_console_list_properties: List the pinned property allowed by the configured identity and grant. Returns stored metadata, not performance totals. Follow nextStartRow until hasMore is false.
search_console_list_pages: List stored pages in the configured property, created by the task snapshot. This is a read-only catalog. Catalog crawl and index fields can differ from a later stored inspection. Use search_console_inspect_url for effective inspection state. Follow nextStartRow until hasMore is false.
search_console_list_queries: List visible query IDs and text with performance in the configured property by the task snapshot. Hidden queries are excluded. This catalog is not a complete breakdown of property totals. Follow nextStartRow until hasMore is false.
search_console_get_record: Read one exact stored property, page, visible query, performance row or URL inspection by its native record key. Hidden-query performance rows are unavailable. Dates and property grants still apply. Viewer-only summaries are not measured evidence.
